notes:
Inbound SMB lead from mobile-first social gaming app 'EchoPals'. Core need: hosted, self-serve API to power real-time in-game chat and lightweight NPC chatter. Primary ask: very low round-trip latency (goal p99 <= 120ms on US mobile networks) and per-user rate limiting + robust abuse/spam controls. Context: 4M installs, daily concurrent rooms ~1.5k, typical room size 10-30 players. Team: CTO Maya R. (technical), Head of Product Leo S., Eng lead Victor H.

What they told us: "We want something we can onboard to in a day and scale without ops overhead — no heavy infra yet." Interested in hosted_api for now; open to Dedicated later if growth requires. Cost sensitivity: high (early monetization), want predictable per-message economics.

Technical constraints/requirements: short messages avg 15 tokens, many rapid back-and-forths (burstiness), need per-user throttles and per-room concurrency limits, automatic profanity/abuse filtering and webhook for escalations to human moderation team. Prefer public_cloud routing (AWS us-east / us-west). Require SSO for admin console (SAML) and audit logs for moderation actions. Data residency note: user content retained for 30 days for abuse review, must support deletion requests.

POC plan: run 1-week POC using hosted API credits; smoke tests include latency profile from mobile (simulated), moderation throughput (msgs/sec), and response format hooks for structured metadata (labels: toxic/spam/ok). They asked for example rate-limit configs and a short sample of batching vs streaming tradeoffs.

Sales notes / AE snippets: call had good vibe — "fast ramp, low ops" repeated. Product team cares about JS/Unity SDK examples. Recommended immediate deliverables: 1) hosted-api quickstart + code snippets for Unity + React Native, 2) moderation and webhook example, 3) p99 latency report for comparable workloads.

Next steps: send quickstart + pricing FAQ (done), attach moderation playbook, propose 30m technical demo week of 2026-03-15. Blockers: need clarification on rate-limit behavior in multi-room bursts and moderation SLOs.
